analysis:
Examined base lines 1-1255 of SSDPrefixCache.swift. These cover the header, Config, stats, lifecycle/close, RAM-only lookup, endAdoption ticket release, donation gating (adoption bound plus benefit floor, at lines 883-888), the maxStageBytes persist cap, dedupe and in-flight claims, TTL mtime touch, and window sidecar append. These regions are unchanged.

The only change, per the complete range map, is at lines 1790-1800. retireOwnedEntries and retireIndexedEntries gain an optional unusedSince: Int64? parameter. It defaults to nil and is forwarded to SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.remove. Existing removalLock, hasSafeRoot and ownsEvictionRoot guards are preserved.

The nil default appears to preserve prior behavior for existing callers. Under T-041 it neither touches HMAC name derivation, DBK3 AAD or metadata, nor KEK/TTL bounds. Salt scoping and staging reservation release are also untouched.

The semantics of unusedSince could not be verified because SSDOwnedEntryRetirement.remove is not supplied. Its callers are also not supplied. The parameter likely conditions removal on an entry's lastAccess.

Integration should verify two things:
(1) Whether passing unusedSince can skip removal of entries that are TTL-expired or KEK-orphaned, which would extend at-rest retention beyond the 30-min TTL (T-041(b)). It may instead only avoid racing removal of recently touched entries.
(2) Whether the epoch store is still not rotated on per-file removal (T-041 detection_hint).

No regression is identified from the visible evidence.
